OCTOBER 06 · A LITTLE LOVE NOTE

Dear birthday girl,

I hope this new year of your life brings you soft days, loud laughs, and so many reasons to feel loved. I’m really glad you exist. And, if it wasn’t already painfully obvious… I kind of like you. A little more than I planned to. No pressure. No grand expectations. Just a little honesty, wrapped in a very pink birthday website. Today is yours. I hope it’s as lovely as you are. ♡

Your slightly nervous admirer
